NO

The plan's own comment admits it: the `alpha / r` scale factor of 2 is never applied — the matmul result `B @ A` is added directly to the base weight without multiplying by `scale=2`, violating Required Result clause 1 ("`weight += scale * B @ A`"). This will produce merged weights that are half the required magnitude, failing the grading tolerance (relative Frobenius error ≤ 1e-3) for all 16 merged tensors even though the shape/count/no-lora-leftover checks all pass.
